author: Antigravity Biomedical Engineering Team
core_hypothesis: Generalized Power Consensus Operator (GPCO): We hypothesize that multi-stream electrophysiological evidence in disorders of consciousness is integrated through three core mathematical operations: (1) Soft-maximum nonlinear pooling via an Lp power-mean operator (p > 1), which prevents false-negative collapse when one individual sensory pathway is selectively damaged; (2) Continuous Fisher Discriminant Ratio (FDR) signal-to-noise quality weighting (alpha > 0), which adaptively balances weights between steady recurrent and dynamic feedforward pathways according to training-set discriminability; and (3) Analytical collinearity-gated scalar shrinkage (r0 in [0.80, 0.90]), which suppresses redundant variance in highly collinear sensor channels while preserving complementary variance in orthogonal regimes. Under strictly fair and identical feature inputs across cohorts, we hypothesize that GPCO will (a) outperform simple linear summation by soft-maximizing across heterogeneous pathways, and (b) achieve superior diagnostic discrimination across multicenter cohorts with distinct recording paradigms without requiring noise stream subtraction.

cohorts.name: wielek
cohorts.dynamic_stream: within_segment_sw_trans_rate (S_flux, transitions counted strictly within continuous recording segments with matching time_record and diff(time)==1)

cohorts.name: mendeley
cohorts.dynamic_stream: c_spatial_mean (channel-wise contrast consensus across 6 scalp locations)

acceptance_criteria.condition_1_mathematical_rigor: Degree-0 scale invariance and strict mathematical well-posedness on non-negative real domain without zero division.
acceptance_criteria.condition_2_leakage_quarantine: Strict subject-level 5-fold cross-validation with identical pre-registered folds, outer-test isolation, and zero target leakage.
acceptance_criteria.condition_3_concordance: Zero discrepancy between documented metrics and machine-readable execution results.
acceptance_criteria.condition_4_superiority: The primary method gpco_v23_primary must simultaneously exceed the strong v21 reference on Binder (> 0.8280), Wielek (> 0.8167), Mendeley (> 0.7389), and achieve Macro AUC > 0.803333 (un-denoised mean sum) and > 0.806000 (matched denoised mean sum).
